capabilities: Add a caret to every table column header
Sort table rows alphabetically or numerically in either direction
Rewrite the markdown file on disk with the new sort order
Undo the last sort via a bindable hotkey
extras: Installation is manual (release files into the plugins folder). No default undo hotkey is set to avoid conflicts; sorting is unavailable when the cursor is inside a table in live preview.
intentEvidence: I came across plugins like Dataview and Advanced Tables, but no click-to-sort like I wanted.
motivation: The author wanted a simple one-click solution to sort tables used for project lists, job trackers, and reading lists, and found no plugin offering click-to-sort.
problem: Obsidian has no one-click way to sort table rows, and existing table plugins are heavier than a simple click-to-sort needs.

summary: Minimalist table sorter that adds a caret to column headers to sort rows A→Z, Z→A, or numerically, rewriting the markdown file in place.
